info.title: Lemma Platform API
info.description: Lemma Platform HTTP API for AI observability and workspace operations.

get.description: Returns projects available to the authenticated tenant.

post.description: Create a project for the authenticated tenant.
Persist project ordering for the authenticated tenant.

get.description: Returns a single project if it belongs to the authenticated tenant.

patch.description: Update a project for the authenticated tenant.

get.description: Returns metric event counts for a project.
Returns request/error/speed/token timeseries + top models for a project over a time range.
Returns per-model trace/token/speed aggregates for a project.
Returns learn-agent and uploaded artifacts for a project, scoped to the selected agent.

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Optional agent name used to scope artifacts. Omit to select the most recently updated artifact agent.

post.description: Upload an agent-scoped .txt or .md file (text/plain or text/markdown).

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Optional agent name to attach to this uploaded artifact.

get.description: Returns learn-agent KB version metadata for a project and agent, newest first. The response omits artifact content.

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Optional agent name used to scope learn-agent artifacts. Empty selects untagged artifacts.

get.description: Returns the learn-agent KB content and metadata for a specific project, agent, and version.

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Optional agent name used to scope learn-agent artifacts. Empty selects untagged artifacts.

post.description: Starts the learn-agent workflow for a tenant-owned project and optional agent. Duplicate project+agent triggers within the dedupe window return the same workflow_id; clients should poll list_project_artifacts for a new latest_version or learn_agent_artifact version to observe completion.

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Optional agent name used to scope the regenerated learn-agent artifacts.

get.description: Returns stored text content and metadata for one uploaded text artifact.
Returns traces for a project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Returns dashboard-ready traces for a project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: failures (span errors), flagged (issue occurrences), or clean.

parameters.name: min_thread_traces
parameters.description: Minimum number of traces in the session/thread.

parameters.name: max_thread_traces
parameters.description: Maximum number of traces in the session/thread.

get.description: Search traces with structural and behavioral filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Search traces by semantic similarity over embedded trace summaries.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Returns agent names seen in project traces.
Returns whether a project has ready traces.
Returns enqueued (Redis index), ingested (ClickHouse traces row), ready (trace_stats), or not_found for a specific otel_trace_id.

parameters.name: otel_trace_id
parameters.description: OTel / SDK trace id to look up.

post.description: Delete multiple traces for a project.

post.summary: Get agent names by trace ids
post.description: Returns a map of trace id to agent name (from ClickHouse trace_stats).

get.description: Resolves a trace from an agent run id.
Returns the trace row, trace_stats row, ordered spans, and issue occurrences for chat/agent context.
Loads a single trace with spans and stats.

delete.description: Delete a trace for a project.

get.description: Returns spans for a ready trace.
Returns previous and next ready traces from the same thread.
Returns every ready trace in the given trace's thread, enriched and ordered oldest first. Empty for standalone traces.
Returns issue occurrence evidence linked to a ready trace.

post.description: Batch-fetch issue extraction completion and destin issues for thread_ids (join key for eval trial_hash).

get.description: List issues for a project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: List dashboard-ready issues for a project.
Get a single issue. The validation field is null when no validation row exists; when present it contains status, confidence, evidenceSummary, checkedTools, caveats, and validatedAt.

patch.description: Update issue lifecycle status. Resolved and dismissed close the issue and append close feedback.

reason.description: Accepted values: False positive, Working as intended, Test or synthetic traffic, Acceptable edge case, Known limitation, Out of scope

get.description: Returns zero-filled daily occurrence buckets for an issue over the last 30 days.
Returns bounded learn-agent and uploaded text artifact context for validation and debugging.
List occurrences for an issue.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Returns the issue, recent occurrences, aggregate stats, and per-trace bundles (trace row + trace_stats + spans) for issue chat.
Build markdown for an issue.
